Name: (CP) and (AT) Floors and Walls by Mila
Author: Stavetskaya
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][color=#f4cccc]This walls and floors are simple and designed to match color schematics with Yellog's WF and [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5857]Rustic Country Walls and Floors[/url][color=#f4cccc] which both I use a lot. Hope you will like them and found useful.[/color]

[color=#b6d7a8]It is safe to install and uninstall both version of the mod whenever you like.[/color]
